findings.text: _import_aliases follows only relative imports whose module starts with graph_store/worker_tasks, so a forwarder that imports its callee by absolute path (from imas_codex.standard_names.graph_store.graph_catalog import write_standard_names as _impl; return _impl(...)) is not matched, although absolute imports are the dominant spelling in this repository (imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:15 uses them), so the forwarder guard misses a forwarder in a spelling the codebase uses.

_owner_modules derives its module set from _OWNERS_BY_MODULE itself, so a store module absent from the map is never scanned, and test_owner_map_covers_every_public_definition therefore cannot report that module's missing public symbols although its docstring claims every store module is covered.

_delegated_name is defined a second time here and diverges from the copy at tests/standard_names/test_facade_closure.py:166: this one neither follows import aliases nor filters local import statements, so the two guards for one property disagree and the weaker copy is blind to the aliased shape the node was fixing.

The evidence table states the bridge serves the 186 collaborators, but _WIRED_SERVICE_NAMES holds 187 entries after f1f266a54 added __file__; the correction paragraph explains the addition and leaves the posted count stale by one.

The reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite record the command with a literal $TMPDIR inside --basetemp, so the recorded command is not the absolute command that ran, and a re-run expands it from the ambient environment and can place the basetemp elsewhere.
